verdict.rationale: Mirrors' own SDK has capture hooks that upload full execution snapshots and stores traces and sessions for review, so it does record agent runs. It positions itself as a corrections tool rather than an observability product, though, and never documents per-call latency or token-usage fields. missing for 10: explicit per-LLM-call input/output trace schema, latency capture, token usage capture, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage
